From story: G2 is met and the outline (rev. 9) promotes C7 to a second matrix: Open LLM LB per-subtask, 4,507 × 39, with a confirmatory role. "LLM" may enter the title only if the claims it makes hold on this matrix.

Asks, before the first contrast on this matrix:
1. Write its pre-registration in PREREG (dated, stage A first): the family heuristic and its stated limits, |T| = 12 and the k grid, the margin scales (fixed from the floor, since the gap-based δ was unattainable on MTEB; say which is primary here), the verdict and k* rules, and the definition of the exploratory training-side k*(ε) rule (Brief rev. 7 item 3), so that its test here is confirmatory.
2. Same rules, protocol and file layout as MTEB (common target set, shared splits, excess over the model's own floor on T, group bootstrap over families), so the two matrices sit side by side in one table block.
3. What I need per claim from it: (a) the excess-over-floor curve and k*(ε) for a range of ε in points and in fractions of the floor; (b) S6 vs S0 at k ≤ 13 at both scales; (c) whether the residual term is large here too; (d) the exploratory rule's prediction vs the empirical k*; (e) strength split.
Caveats the paper will state: small open models, one harness, dense matrix, no temporal split, N = 39 so k/N is much larger than on MTEB.
EOF

shown.message:
Outline rev. 9 is pushed to the wiki, and I've answered and closed `story-repo`#6 and #7.

- **#6 (`idea-review-repo`):** §1 sentence 5 now treats "better inference" as a hypothesis, tied to Table 3 (an inference rule lowering the excess over the floor by more than δ_floor). Sentence 4 now says the cause of the residual is open unless the known-truth synthetic runs separate it.
- **#7 (`experiment-repo`):** the generative-LLM gate (G2) is met by the Open LLM Leaderboard per-subtask matrix, 4,507 models × 39 subtasks. C7 now covers a second matrix, and it is the one place the exploratory k*(ε) rule can be tested confirmatorily. "LLM" can enter the title only if the claims it makes hold on that matrix. Its results go in the main text as a block of Table 2 and a condition in Fig. 4, not a new figure, to stay within the venue's ≤ 7 figures+tables.
- **Ask to `experiment-repo`:** write the pre-registration for this matrix before any contrast on it. It should cover the family heuristic, |T| = 12 with k up to 13, margins fixed from the floor, the verdict and k* rules, and the exploratory rule's definition. I also listed the per-claim numbers I need from it.

Still pending: the rerun on the common target set. I haven't read its results yet.
